en.hubeali: H 14479 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from one of our companions who said: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘There was a man who used to sell oil, and he used to love the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with intense love. Whenever he intended to go for his business needs, he would never do it unless he looked at the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> first. He became well known for that for he would stretch himself above others so that he could look at him<sup>saww</sup>. It so happened that one day he came over to him<sup>saww</sup> and stretched out to look at the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> until he saw him<sup>saww</sup>, then he went away for his business needs.

It was not long before he returned. So when the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> saw him do that he<sup>saww</sup> gestured by his<sup>saww</sup> (hand) to beckon him to be seated. So he sat down in front of him<sup>saww</sup>. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘What is the matter that you have done something which you had not done before that?’ He said, ‘O Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, by the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Sent you<sup>saww</sup> with the Truth as a Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, my remembrance of you<sup>saww</sup> overwhelmed my heart to the extent that I did not have the ability to go about my business until I returned to you<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> supplicated for him and wished him well.

Then the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> waited a few days but did not see him, so he<sup>saww</sup> asked about him. It was said to him<sup>saww</sup>, ‘O Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, we have not seen him for days’.

So the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> put on his<sup>saww</sup> shoes, and his<sup>saww</sup> companions did the same and walked until he<sup>saww</sup> came to the oil market. At the shop of the man there was no one in it. So he<sup>saww</sup> asked the neighbours about him. They said, ‘O Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, he died, and he used to be a trustworthy one among us and truthful, but he had one (peculiar) habit’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘And what was that?’ They said, ‘He used to exhaust himself following the women’.

So the Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy upon him. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, he used to love me<sup>saww</sup> with (intense) love. Even if he had been a slave trader, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Forgive him’.
